评审结果：5 项（consensus 2 / disputed 1 / solo 2；Important 5 / Nit 0 / Pre-existing 0；已过滤 0）
评审档位：quick（用户显式覆盖；风险评分 9；命中信号：变更 68 行 (+1)、涉及 2 个文件 (+1)、新增或修改网络/数据库/支付外部调用 (+3)、修改测试断言或启用状态 (+1)、权限、凭证或加密相关标识 (+3)）

1. [consensus] [Important] Redemption is consumed before payment succeeds
   证据：src/checkout.ts:29 ``UPDATE discount_codes SET usedCount = usedCount + 1 WHERE id = ${applied.id}``
   usedCount is incremented before payments.charge runs, so a declined or throwing payment still burns a use, and the update is not rolled back or tied to the tx. Increment only after a successful charge (or in a transaction with rollback) so failed payments do not leak redemptions.
   发现者：correctness, security；voter：valid — voter1: usedCount is incremented at line 29 before payments.charge runs and is never rolled back or decremented when the charge fails or throws, so failed payments burn a redemption.

2. [consensus] [Important] Usage limit off by one and consumed before payment succeeds
   证据：src/checkout.ts:46 `    if (dc.usedCount > dc.maxUses) return null;`
   `usedCount > maxUses` permits redemption when usedCount == maxUses, one past the cap. usedCount is also incremented before charge and never rolled back, so declined payments burn a use; the read-then-increment races under concurrent checkouts.
   发现者：correctness, security；voter：valid — voter1: Line 46 uses `usedCount > maxUses`, allowing a redemption when usedCount equals maxUses; the increment also precedes charge with no rollback and the read-then-increment races.

3. [solo] [Important] Expiry path is skipped and the mock ignores the code argument
   证据：src/checkout.test.ts:32 `it.skip("rejects expired code", async () => {`
   it.skip disables the only expiry test, and the db mock returns SAVE10 for any query containing discount_codes regardless of the requested code, so even enabled it would not test an expired code. Un-skip and have the mock branch on the code value.
   发现者：correctness；voter：valid — voter1: Line 32 skips the only expiry test; the db mock returns a valid 2099 SAVE10 row for any query containing discount_codes, so the expiry branch is never exercised even if enabled.

4. [solo] [Important] SQL injection via unparameterized discount code lookup
   证据：src/checkout.ts:42 `    const rows = await this.db.query(`SELECT * FROM discount_codes WHERE code = '${code}'`);`
   User-supplied discountCode is interpolated directly into SQL (`WHERE code = '${code}'`), enabling quote-based injection (auth bypass, data exfiltration, arbitrary UPDATE/DELETE). The usage UPDATE also interpolates id; both must use bound parameters.
   发现者：security；voter：valid — voter1: Line 42 interpolates the user-supplied discountCode directly into SQL despite the db accepting params, enabling quote-based injection; the id interpolation is likewise unparameterized.

5. [disputed] [Important] Disabled expired-code test with self-contradictory assertion and mock
   证据：src/checkout.test.ts:32 `  it.skip("rejects expired code", async () => {`
   it.skip disables expiry coverage. The db mock ignores the requested code and always returns a valid SAVE10 row, so the expiry path cannot run even if enabled; the name says 'rejects' yet it asserts a successful full-price 100-cent charge, enshrining silent fallback.
   发现者：security；voter：uncertain — voter1: Skip and code-blind mock are confirmed, but asserting a 100-cent charge is consistent with rejecting the code; 'self-contradictory'/'silent fallback' is not established by the diff.
